answer: The nectar counter is kept in velvet and dawn reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3582 identities would post 2619 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
